environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. No authentication middleware on the debug controller. Environment variables include DATABASE_URL with embedded credentials, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, STRIPE_API_KEY, and KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD (note: the sanitization regex only matches exact key names PASSWORD, SECRET, PRIVATE_KEY - not compound names like KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD or STRIPE_API_KEY).
